warnings: PNG contains two portrait ปร.4 sheets side by side (each rotated 90 degrees) combined into one landscape scan; split at x=1428-1822 (confirmed blank gutter), full-height halves, rotated 90 deg clockwise. Unit 'บ่อ' (pit/tank) is printed for BOTH 3.3.1 (septic tank) and 3.3.2 (grease trap) - transcribed exactly as printed even though a grease trap would more typically be counted 'ถัง' (a unit actually used elsewhere on ถังเก็บน้ำ, item 3.2.13); not silently changed.

This sheet's own header reads '3.3 ระบบสุขาภิบาลภายนอกอาคาร' (no 'งานระบบ' prefix), differing slightly from the rollup sheet's (หน้า73_1) 'งานระบบสุขาภิบาลภายนอกอาคาร' - transcribed exactly as printed on each sheet, see also the note on หน้า73_1.
The sludge/filter-volume note ('ส่วนแยกกาก...') is a spec continuation of item 3.3.1 with no printed item_no/qty/unit of its own - transcribed as its own item per spec §11's continuation-row rule.
All unit-price/amount columns are blank in the source for every row, including the 'รวมข้อ 3.3' subtotal row - transcribed as null, not invented.
